title: Antiquus Mundus
description: A non serious semi-vanilla medieval fantasy roleplay smp.
body:
***LORE***:
> Driven by a hunger for adventure, you turned your back on a fading home to sail across the Great Ocean in search of a new beginning.

***FEATURES***:
- EXPLORATION - Find new structures, dungeons and new biomes.
- PER PLAYER LOOT - All structures new or old have per player loot (they also refresh over a dynamic time based on structure).
- CLAIMS - Claim a chunk or chunks with our interactive claim system.
- INCREASED SPAWNS - Peaceful, Hostile and Ambient mobs have been increased in numbers. 
- INTERACTTIVE - The familiar and nostalgic feel of Minecraft is intact. No typing commands. Interact with our server as if you are there!
